EVENT INVITATION

Commercial Real Estate Forum: Australia 2026

The Commercial Real Estate Forum: Australia brings together the investors, fund managers, developers and operators behind Australia’s commercial real estate market for a day focused on capital, strategy and dealmaking.    

 

 Gain an inside view of where investors see value, how allocation priorities are changing and which sectors are attracting capital. From emerging asset classes and development economics to private credit and investment strategy, hear directly from the decision-makers navigating today’s market. 

WHEN


Wednesday
November 4, 2026

WHERE


Sheraton Grand Sydney Hyde Park

Ticket Includes:
  • Full conference access to all sessions, giving you the opportunity to hear the latest market insights, trends and perspectives from industry leaders.
  • 3+ hours of dedicated networking to build valuable connections with peers through breakfast networking, scheduled breaks and an evening drinks reception.
  • Exclusive conference app access to explore the attendee list, connect with fellow delegates and maximise your networking opportunities.
  •  Daily meals, including a light breakfast, buffet lunch and coffee breaks.
Register Now

Hear directly from leading voices at AEW, Altus Property Group, Australian Super, Brookfield, GIC, Housing Australia, Lendlease, Lowry Property Group, Macquarie Asset Management, Ray White, Victorian Funds Management Corporation, and more!

 

View the agenda and list of speakers here >>

 Meet the industry professionals behind Australia’s commercial real estate activity and build valuable connections with organisations actively investing, developing and operating in the market.

If your organization is focused on raising capital, deploying funds, or structuring deals in Australia, sponsoring this event places you exactly where the market is moving.

 

 Download the sponsorship brochure for further details or contact our team to discuss how we can tailor a sponsorship package to meet your strategic objectives.

bcole@greenstreet.com

A premier forum for deal-making in Australia, connecting investors, developers, and financiers to explore region's infrastructure financing gap.
